all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Direct the Office of Economic and Workforce Development (OEWD) to clear the recruitment and intake bottlenecks flagged in the C102 executive review of the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Direct the Office of Economic and Workforce Development (OEWD) to clear the recruitment and intake bottlenecks flagged in the C102 executive review of the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
- **Why:** The program remains stalled with recruitment failures leading into the C104 findings report, requiring immediate executive intervention to unblock intake.
- **Acceptance:** An executive directive instructing the program team on specific intake adjustments to be evaluated in C104.
- **Silence consequence:** The apprenticeship pipeline will fail its pilot phase, leaving vulnerable youth without jobs and wasting allocated municipal resources.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Transmit the formal INIT-007 Review Findings and Corrective Actions Report to City Council to resolve apprenticeship intake bottlenecks and stabilize executive policy direction following the 13-point approval drop in C104.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Transmit the formal INIT-007 Review Findings and Corrective Actions Report to City Council to resolve apprenticeship intake bottlenecks and stabilize executive policy direction following the 13-point approval drop in C104.
- **Why:** The Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) is scheduled for its C104 review findings deliverable after executive intervention in C103, coinciding with a drop in mayoral approval from 95 to 82 in C104.
- **Acceptance:** Public transmission of the INIT-007 corrective actions report containing revised intake targets and operational adjustments.
- **Silence consequence:** INIT-007 stalls in pilot phase without authorized corrective workflows, leaving municipal workforce commitments unmet.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Transmit the interagency administrative order directing OEWD and partner agencies to clear the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) backlog before the C106 town hall deadline.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Transmit the interagency administrative order directing OEWD and partner agencies to clear the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) backlog before the C106 town hall deadline.
- **Why:** Following C104 corrective plan filings and the executive approval shift to 69 in C105, executive authority must enforce partner intake processing to meet the C106 pilot clearance deadline.
- **Acceptance:** An issued executive order or administrative directive mandating pipeline intake processing targets across participating municipal departments.
- **Silence consequence:** The INIT-007 backlog remains unresolved into C106, compromising youth workforce commitments and administrative follow-through.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Convene the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) public town hall and certify zero remaining backlog cases across municipal partner agencies.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Convene the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) public town hall and certify zero remaining backlog cases across municipal partner agencies.
- **Why:** Administrative orders issued in C105 established C106 as the deadline for clearing the intake backlog and conducting the public town hall, amid a 5-point drop in executive approval (64 in C106).
- **Acceptance:** Official certification of backlog clearance and a published town hall transcript or outcomes summary.
- **Silence consequence:** Failure to verify intake processing leaves applicants stalled and unresolved oversight questions for the administration.

all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Convene the public town hall enrollment event for the Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007) and certify operational rollout.
- **Why:** Following backlog clearance verified in C106, tracker sequencing sets the public enrollment launch in C107 as the gating operational milestone.
- **Acceptance:** A published town hall enrollment report documenting open applicant intake and training cohort placement targets.
- **Silence consequence:** The cleared intake pipeline remains dormant without executive launch of public enrollment.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Authorize the design consultant selection for Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II (INIT-003) and publish the first training cohort placement metrics for the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Authorize the design consultant selection for Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II (INIT-003) and publish the first training cohort placement metrics for the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline (INIT-007).
- **Why:** Following C107 design RFP issuance and public town hall enrollment, C108 marks the scheduled milestone for INIT-003 consultant award and INIT-007 placement review; all six board initiatives sit at stall-clock threshold (NextActionCycle ≤ C109).
- **Acceptance:** Executive authorization selecting the INIT-003 design consultant and a published INIT-007 placement audit establishing initial cohort numbers across city districts.
- **Silence consequence:** Transit hub pre-development stalls at procurement, while enrolled apprenticeship applicants remain unassigned to active job placements.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — File legislative language for Downtown Economic Revitalization (INIT-008) and formalize executive execution on month-eight disbursements for INIT-001 and the design consultant contract for INIT-003.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative language for Downtown Economic Revitalization (INIT-008) and formalize executive execution on month-eight disbursements for INIT-001 and the design consultant contract for INIT-003.
- **Why:** The executive board carries 8 constituent complaints above the visibility threshold with zero filed legislative proposals, while seven initiatives (INIT-001, INIT-002, INIT-003, INIT-005, INIT-006, INIT-007, INIT-008) sit at the C110 stall-clock deadline; INIT-008 missed its C108 filing milestone.
- **Acceptance:** Formal filing of the INIT-008 revitalization ordinance text with the City Clerk and published executive orders confirming INIT-001 month-eight allocations and the INIT-003 design award.
- **Silence consequence:** Citywide capital sequencing bottlenecks across seven active initiatives, leaving Downtown commercial corridors without statutory relief and stalling pre-development citywide.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — File legislative text for INIT-009 and INIT-010 with the City Clerk and docket formal administrative responses to the three standing citizen petitions.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative text for INIT-009 and INIT-010 with the City Clerk and docket formal administrative responses to the three standing citizen petitions.
- **Why:** INIT-009 (Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake) and INIT-010 (West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund) were announced with legislation-filed milestones set for C110 and sit unfiled heading into the C112 stall threshold, while three verified citizen petitions have crossed the visibility line with no executive proposal introduced.
- **Acceptance:** Formal filing of draft ordinances for INIT-009 and INIT-010, alongside a recorded mayoral action on the three pending petition items in C112.
- **Silence consequence:** Both initiatives lapse into administrative stall under charter tracking, and executive inaction on verified citizen petitions becomes the city record.

all.demand: Avery Santana — Mayor — Publish the Month-11 disbursement audit for INIT-001, the OARI quarterly outcome report for INIT-002, and the first cohort placement data for INIT-007, while resolving the two standing citizen complaints on the executive ledger.
all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** Publish the Month-11 disbursement audit for INIT-001, the OARI quarterly outcome report for INIT-002, and the first cohort placement data for INIT-007, while resolving the two standing citizen complaints on the executive ledger.
- **Why:** Eight initiatives on the mayoral board (INIT-001, INIT-002, INIT-005, INIT-007, INIT-008, INIT-009, INIT-010, INIT-011) carry stall clocks expiring at or before C113, with three core operational reviews (INIT-001, INIT-002, INIT-007) overdue as of C112.
- **Acceptance:** Published executive deliverable reports for INIT-001, INIT-002, and INIT-007, plus recorded disposition of the two citizen complaints in C113.
- **Silence consequence:** Administrative tracking records multiple executive milestone defaults across stabilization, safety dispatch, and youth workforce pipelines.

all.sourceText:
## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative proposals addressing the 4 citizen complaints above the visibility threshold and execute the Month-12 disbursement and charter renewal for INIT-001.
- **Why:** The mayoral ledger carries 4 citizen complaints above the visibility threshold without responsive proposals filed, while 10 board initiatives face C114 stall clock deadlines including INIT-001's Month-12 renewal and INIT-007's placement gap analysis.
- **Acceptance:** Formal legislative or administrative filings on the 4 citizen petitions and published Month-12 closeout documentation for INIT-001 in C114.
- **Silence consequence:** Executive default across multiple active initiatives and public breach of the charter visibility threshold for citizen petitions.
